title: Logarithmic bound for a polynomial expression
statement: For all natural numbers $a$, $k$, and $m$, the base-$2$ ceiling logarithm satisfies $\operatorname{clog}_2\!\bigl(a(m+1)^k\bigr)\le a+k\bigl(\operatorname{log}_2(m)+1\bigr)$.
